title: Random block drops 2
description: A balanced randomizer for Minecraft 26.1+ where every block drops a random item based on a weighted tier system. It's fun, trust me.
body:
# Balanced Random Block Drops (26.1+)

This datapack overhauls Minecraft's loot system, making every block drop a random item when mined. Just install, reload, and experience a fresh, unpredictable survival challenge.

## Features

- **Latest Version Support:** Fully compatible with Minecraft Java Edition 26.1+

- **Balanced Progression:** Features a weighted tier system so the game remains playable. You won't find Netherite in every dirt block, but the excitement of a rare drop is always there!
  - **Common (70%):** Building blocks, basic resources, and common items.
  - **Uncommon (20%):** Iron tier gear, useful food, and mid range materials.
  - **Rare (8%):** Gold, Diamonds, Emeralds, and specialized utility items.
  - **Epic (1.5%):** Ancient Debris, Totems, Elytras, and Shulker Shells.
  - **Legendary (0.5%):** Netherite Ingots, Beacons, Tridents, and the new Heavy Core.

- **Multiplayer Ready:** Works flawlessly in singleplayer and on dedicated servers.

## Installation

1. Download the `balanced_random_block_drop_v2.zip` file.

1. Navigate to your Minecraft world folder and place the zip in the `datapacks` directory.

1. Launch the world or run the `/reload` command if already in game.

1. Start mining and discover what the world has to offer!

## Notes

- **Weighted Randomization:** Drops are calculated dynamically using weighted loot tables to ensure a balanced gameplay experience.

- **Vanilla Focus:** This pack overrides vanilla block loot tables. Modded blocks are currently not affected.

- **Safe Removal:** You can remove the datapack at any time without risking world corruption.
